value.behaviour: Extend getLassoSelectedElementIds with a boxSelectionMode parameter supporting full outline, bound-text, and frame-clipped enclosure in Wrap ("contain") mode while preserving existing Overlap ("overlap") behaviour.
rules: 1. Import elementOverlapsWithFrame, getContainingFrame, getElementLineSegments, isBoundToContainer, and pointInsideBoundsInclusive from "@excalidraw/element", lineSegmentIntersectionPoints and pointFrom from "@excalidraw/math", type LineSegment from "@excalidraw/math/types", and type BoxSelectionMode from "../types".
2. Add optional boxSelectionMode?: BoxSelectionMode to getLassoSelectedElementIds input parameter, destructuring with default boxSelectionMode = "contain".

3. In getLassoSelectedElementIds loop over unlockedElements, when boxSelectionMode === "contain" and isBoundToContainer(element) is true, skip the element so standalone bound text never selects a partially enclosed container.

4. For each candidate element in "contain" mode, check const associatedFrame = getContainingFrame(element, elementsMap) and when associatedFrame && elementOverlapsWithFrame(element, associatedFrame, elementsMap), compute frameBounds = getElementBounds(associatedFrame, elementsMap) and clip elementBounds to [Math.max(elementBounds[0], frameBounds[0]), Math.max(elementBounds[1], frameBounds[1]), Math.min(elementBounds[2], frameBounds[2]), Math.min(elementBounds[3], frameBounds[3])] as Bounds (matching elementsOverlappingBBox); in "overlap" mode leave frameBounds = null and elementBounds unclipped.
5. Keep the fast AABB pre-filter doBoundsIntersect(lassoBounds, elementBounds) && !intersectedElements.has(element.id) && !enclosedElements.has(element.id).

6. When boxSelectionMode === "contain", add element.id to enclosedElements if and only if enclosureTest(path, element, elementsSegments, elementsMap, "contain", frameBounds, elementBounds) is true AND !intersectionTest(path, element, elementsMap, elementsSegments.get(element.id), frameBounds) is true; do not add anything to intersectedElements in "contain" mode.

7. When boxSelectionMode === "overlap", preserve exact existing behaviour: if enclosureTest(path, element, elementsSegments, elementsMap, "overlap") is true add element.id to enclosedElements, else if intersectionTest(path, element, elementsMap) is true add element.id to intersectedElements.

8. Implement a helper clipSegmentToBounds([p0, p1]: LineSegment<GlobalPoint>, [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]: Bounds): LineSegment<GlobalPoint> | null using Liang-Barsky parameter clipping on [0, 1] against [minX, minY, maxX, maxY], and clipSegmentsToBounds(segments, bounds) returning the non-null clipped segments.

9. In enclosureTest(lassoPath, element, elementsSegments, elementsMap, mode = "overlap", frameBounds = null, clippedElementBounds?): resolve rawSegments = elementsSegments.get(element.id) ?? getElementLineSegments(element, elementsMap); if !rawSegments || rawSegments.length === 0 return false; when mode === "overlap" return rawSegments.some((segment) => segment.some((point) => polygonIncludesPointNonZero(point, lassoPolygon))).

10. In enclosureTest when mode === "contain", if frameBounds is non-null, clip rawSegments via clipSegmentsToBounds(rawSegments, frameBounds) (falling back to the 4 boundary segments of clippedElementBounds if all outline segments lie outside frameBounds because the element surrounds the frame), and require every segment endpoint to satisfy polygonIncludesPointNonZero(point, lassoPolygon); additionally, if getBoundTextElement(element, elementsMap) returns a boundTextElement, construct positionedBoundText = { ...boundTextElement, ...computeBoundTextPosition(element, boundTextElement, elementsMap) }, compute boundTextSegments = frameBounds ? clipSegmentsToBounds(getElementLineSegments(positionedBoundText, elementsMap), frameBounds) : getElementLineSegments(positionedBoundText, elementsMap), and require every endpoint in boundTextSegments (when non-empty, or when frameBounds is null require boundTextSegments.length > 0) to satisfy polygonIncludesPointNonZero(point, lassoPolygon).

11. In intersectionTest(lassoPath, element, elementsMap, elementSegments?, frameBounds = null), when frameBounds is null keep existing intersectElementWithLineSegment(..., 0, true) checks on element and positioned boundTextElement plus elementSegments.some((seg) => lineSegmentIntersectionPoints(lassoSegment, seg) !== null) when elementSegments is provided; when frameBounds is non-null, call intersectElementWithLineSegment(..., 0, false) on element and positioned boundTextElement and only count hits where pointInsideBoundsInclusive(hit, frameBounds) is true, and clip elementSegments with clipSegmentsToBounds(elementSegments, frameBounds) before testing lineSegmentIntersectionPoints.

value.behaviour: Pass appState.boxSelectionMode from LassoTrail.updateSelection into getLassoSelectedElementIds and enforce Wrap ("contain") vs Overlap ("overlap") bound-text and group selection semantics in LassoTrail.selectElementsFromIds.
rules: 1. Import isBoundToContainer alongside isFrameLikeElement, isLinearElement, isTextElement from "@excalidraw/element".

2. In LassoTrail.selectElementsFromIds bound-text loop, only set nextSelectedElementIds[container.id] = true when prevState.boxSelectionMode === "overlap", and always delete nextSelectedElementIds[element.id] when container exists.

3. In LassoTrail.selectElementsFromIds after removing children of selected frames, when prevState.boxSelectionMode === "contain", build a groups: Record<string, ExcalidrawElement[]> map over this.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements() skipping any element where element.locked || isBoundToContainer(element) and indexing by const groupId = element.groupIds.at(-1).

4. Still inside the prevState.boxSelectionMode === "contain" branch, iterate over Object.keys(nextSelectedElementIds), look up element = this.app.scene.getNonDeletedElement(id), resolve group = element?.groupIds.at(-1) ? groups[element.groupIds.at(-1)!] : null, and if group && !group.every((groupElement) => nextSelectedElementIds[groupElement.id]), delete nextSelectedElementIds[id] before calling selectGroupsForSelectedElements.
5. In LassoTrail.updateSelection, pass boxSelectionMode: this.app.state.boxSelectionMode in the argument object to getLassoSelectedElementIds.

tests.name: rejects partially overlapped rectangle in contain mode and selects it in overlap mode
tests.given: A rectangle at (0, 0, 100, 100) and a lasso path that clips only its top-left corner
tests.expect: Selected elements are empty in "contain" mode and [rect.id] in "overlap" mode, and a fully enclosing lasso selects [rect.id] in "contain" mode

tests.name: selects rounded rectangle when lasso encloses its rounded outline even if cutting sharp AABB corners
tests.given: A rounded rectangle (roundness: ADAPTIVE_RADIUS) and a lasso polygon passing inside the sharp AABB corners but outside the rounded corner arcs
tests.expect: The rounded rectangle is selected in "contain" mode

tests.name: evaluates full outline containment for diamond and ellipse in contain mode
tests.given: A diamond and an ellipse tested with a partial lasso vs a lasso that encloses the shape outline while cutting through empty AABB corners
tests.expect: Partial lasso leaves each unselected in "contain" and selected in "overlap"; outline-enclosing lasso selects each in "contain"

tests.name: evaluates full outline containment for rotated shapes in contain mode
tests.given: A rotated rectangle (angle: Math.PI / 4) tested with a lasso clipping one rotated corner vs a lasso enclosing all four rotated corners
tests.expect: Corner-clipping lasso leaves the rotated rectangle unselected in "contain" and selected in "overlap"; full rotated-outline lasso selects it in "contain"

tests.name: evaluates full outline containment for lines, arrows, and freedraw strokes in contain mode
tests.given: A line, an arrow, and a freedraw element tested with a lasso enclosing only part of the stroke vs the entire stroke
tests.expect: Partial lasso leaves each unselected in "contain" and selected in "overlap"; full lasso selects each in "contain"

tests.name: requires bound text and arrow labels to be enclosed with their container or arrow in contain mode
tests.given: A rectangle with bound text (lasso enclosing only the bound text vs both) and an arrow with a bound text label (lasso enclosing only the arrow shaft vs both arrow and label)
tests.expect: Enclosing only bound text or only the arrow shaft leaves the element unselected in "contain" and selected in "overlap"; enclosing both selects the container/arrow in "contain"

tests.name: selects a group in contain mode only when all selectable group members are enclosed
tests.given: Two grouped rectangles (with bound text on one member) tested with a lasso enclosing one member vs all members
tests.expect: Enclosing one member selects nothing in "contain" and the whole group in "overlap"; enclosing all selectable members selects the group and sets selectedGroupIds in "contain"

tests.name: clips a frame child to its containing frame in contain mode while keeping overlap mode unclipped
tests.given: A frame at (0, 0, 100, 100) and a child rectangle at (50, 20, 100, 60) with frameId: frame.id extending to x = 150 past the frame's right edge
tests.expect: A lasso enclosing the visible portion inside the frame (x: 40..105, y: 10..90, crossing the frame's right edge at x = 100) selects the child and not the frame in "contain" mode, and selects the frame and not the child in "overlap" mode; a lasso enclosing only the hidden portion outside the frame (x: 110..160, y: 10..90) leaves the child unselected in "contain" mode and selects the child in "overlap" mode
